h1: Garage Door Services in Milton Keynes

summary: Garage door repairs, servicing, springs and cables, automation, replacement and supply-and-fit installation across Milton Keynes.
body:
Our garage door services in Milton Keynes cover everything from fixing a door that has stuck halfway to supplying and fitting a brand-new electric door. Whatever the job, you get honest advice, a clear written quote and work carried out by experienced garage door fitters. Here is how to work out which service you need.

My garage door is broken or not working properly

Start with garage door repairs. We repair up and over, roller, sectional and side hinged doors from all major manufacturers, including locks, handles, rollers, tracks and panels. We aim to get to repairs quickly, often the same or next day.

  • If the door suddenly became very heavy, dropped, or you heard a loud bang, it is likely a spring or cable problem. Do not keep using the door — springs and cables are under high tension and should be dealt with by a professional.
  • If it is an electric door that won't open, close or respond to the remote, see electric garage door repairs. Our guide to an electric garage door not working also covers a few safe checks you can do first.

My door works but could be better

Garage door servicing is a planned check and adjustment: we inspect springs, cables, rollers, hinges and fixings, lubricate moving parts, check balance and safety features, and tell you about anything that is wearing. Regular servicing can head off breakdowns and extend the life of the door.

If you are happy with your door but tired of lifting it by hand, garage door automation adds an electric operator and remote controls to many existing doors.

I want a new garage door

If your door is past its best, our garage door replacement service takes care of everything, from measuring to removing and disposing of the old door. Our supply and fit installation page explains what happens on fitting day. If you are unsure whether to fix or replace, read our guide on repairing versus replacing a garage door.

Garage door repair and installation prices

We know price is a big part of the decision. Our garage door prices page gives indicative guide ranges for new doors fitted, automation and common repairs. Every price is confirmed in writing after a free survey or inspection, and there is no obligation to go ahead.

To speed things up, send us a photo of your door, a short description of the problem and your postcode. We can often identify the make and the likely fix before we arrive. Send an enquiry or call {{PHONE}}.

Repair, service or replace?

Not sure which service you need? This is how we usually decide on site.

What you're seeingUsually needs
Door is heavy, noisy or sticks part wayA service: adjustment, lubrication and checks
Door won't open, cable snapped or spring brokenA repair, often springs and cables
Remote or motor stopped workingAn electric door repair
Door is rusted, dented or very oldA replacement
Door works but you want it electricAutomation

What happens when you call

Tell us what the door is doing and, if you can, send a photo. For repairs we explain any call-out charge before we visit, and once we've diagnosed the fault we give you a price before doing the work. For new doors we book a free survey, measure up and send a written quote. If a repair wouldn't be good value, we'll say so; our guide on whether to repair or replace explains how we decide.

All makes, all door types

We work on up and over, roller, sectional and side hinged doors, in steel, timber, GRP, aluminium and composite, from all the common manufacturers. That includes motors and remotes from the main operator brands. Whether you need a quick fix, a yearly service, an upgrade to electric or a complete new door, the process is the same: we explain the options and the price before any work starts.

Where we provide our services

We provide garage door servicing and repairs across Milton Keynes and nearby towns, including Bedford, Northampton and Buckingham. See our areas we cover page for the full list. All our garage door services are listed below.

faqs.q: Do you repair all makes of garage door?
faqs.a: Yes. We repair all major makes, including doors from Hörmann, Garador, Cardale, Henderson, Novoferm and SWS, along with many older and less common doors. Some discontinued doors need parts that are hard to find; if that is the case we will explain the options, which may include a compatible replacement part or, if it makes more sense, a new door.

faqs.q: How quickly can you come out for a garage door repair?
faqs.a: We aim to get to repairs quickly — often the same or next day, depending on where you are and how busy we are. If your door is stuck open and your home is insecure, tell us when you call so we can prioritise. Sending a photo of the door beforehand helps us bring the right parts.

faqs.q: How often should a garage door be serviced?
faqs.a: Most manufacturers recommend an annual service for a garage door, especially electric doors and doors with springs and cables. A service checks balance, fixings and safety features, lubricates moving parts and catches worn components early. Doors that are used many times a day may benefit from more frequent checks.

faqs.q: Is it cheaper to repair or replace a garage door?
faqs.a: A repair is usually cheaper in the short term, and many problems such as a broken cable, worn rollers or a faulty remote are inexpensive to fix. Replacement becomes better value when the door is badly corroded, rotten, damaged or repeatedly failing, or when you want insulation or electric operation. We will give you an honest view after inspecting the door.

faqs.q: Do you repair all makes of garage door?
faqs.a: Yes. We repair all common makes and types of garage door, including up and over, roller, sectional and side hinged doors, and their motors and remotes, whoever originally fitted them.
